lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"It would indeed,[01]Highness.[02]I shall go[01]investigate the[01]disturbance myself."

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"Are you certain we[01]need not surround[01]our self with guards?[02]We are concerned for[01]our safety!"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Well, Highness...[02]I'm afraid all the[01]guards in the world[02]wouldn't make much[01]difference should the[01]God Emperor appear."

lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Bem, Alteza... [02]Receio que todos os guardas do mundo [02]fariam pouca diferenca se o Deus Imperador aparecesse."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Besides, I, ever[01]your faithful and[01]devoted servant,[02]will lay down my life[01]if need be to protect[02]you by confining the[01]Emperor [04][06] in[01]a web of magic.[02]Please, Highness,[01]let your heart be[01]at ease!"

lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Alem disso, serei seu servo fiel e dedicado, [02]pronto a sacrificar minha vida, se necessario, para protege-lo [02]aprisionando o Imperador [04][06] numa teia de magia. Por favor, Alteza, fique tranquilo!"

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"Very well.[02]We are counting on[01]you, Yuna."

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][82]B"Well! If it isn't[01][04][06], the God[01]Emperor...[02]Allow me to[01]congratulate[01]you on your[02]triumphant return,[01]Your Majesty. I..."

lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][82]B"Bem! Se nao e [04][06], o Deus Imperador... [02]Permita que eu o cumprimente pelo seu [02]retorno triunfal, Vossa Majestade. Eu..."

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][82]B"Well! I'm afraid[01]I can't let you[01]through, Majesty."

lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][82]B"Bem! Receio que nao possa deixa-lo passa, Majestade."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][82]B"Today, your journey[01]ends here.[02]Do not worry--we will[01]merely seal off your[02]power and return you[01]to your place of[01]rest."

lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][82]B"Hoje seu trajeto termina aqui. [02]Nao se preocupe--apenas selamos seu poder e o retornamos [02]ao seu lugar de descanso."
lines.risk_notes: [02] marca quebra; tom precisamente ameacador mas controlado

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][82]B"Well! I suppose I[01]should have known[01]better...[02]It would appear that[01]here, in this castle[01]you built,[02]your powers have[01]fully returned."
lines.speaker: Yuna
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][82]B"Bem! Suponho que deria ter sabido... [02]Parece que aqui, neste castelo que construiu, [02]seus poderes totalmente retornaram."
lines.risk_notes: [02] marca quebra; Yuna reconhece derrota; tom desapontado

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][82]B"Well then, far be it[01]from me to stand in[01]your way, Majesty."

lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][82]B"Bem entao, nao e da minha alcada obsta-lo, Majestade."
